title: Software Consultant - Personalization
description:
OSF Digital is a leading global digital transformation company, operating in over 30 countries worldwide. As a Salesforce Partner, we specialize in providing innovative solutions to help businesses achieve their digital goals. We are proud to be the only global Salesforce partner recognized in the top 5 categories, highlighting our commitment to excellence and customer success. With a strong focus on leveraging cutting-edge technologies and industry best practices, our team of experts is dedicated to driving growth and efficiency for our clients across various industries. Embracing a 100% remote culture for over 20 years, we are committed to flexibility and work-life balance for our employees.


Position: Personalization Specialist

We are seeking a skilled Personalization Specialist to join our team in Porto. The ideal candidate will be responsible for implementing and maintaining the Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization platform, ensuring effective and continuous campaign management.

Responsibilities:

• Implement and maintain the Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization platform.

• Develop and manage Personalization sitemaps using JavaScript, following the platform’s library and standards.

• Create and customize campaign templates, adapting global models or developing solutions from scratch.

• Collaborate with marketing and development teams to integrate the platform with other systems, ensuring campaign effectiveness and continuity.

• Monitor campaign performance and propose improvements to optimize results.

Requirements:

• Proven experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization (Interaction Studio/Evergage).

• Skilled in developing Personalization sitemaps using JavaScript.

• Proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript.

• Experience creating and customizing campaign templates.

• Strong teamwork skills with a results-oriented mindset.

Nice to Have:

• Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement.

• Certifications in Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization.

• Developer certification in Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement.

Languages:

• English is not mandatory but considered a plus.


OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business.

title: Consultor (a) Técnico (a) Comercial Modernização II
description:
Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Responsável comercial de seu território, com acompanhamento mais próximo da gestão, tem o objetivo de desenvolver relacionamento com o cliente, mantendo-o em sua carteira, focando em reparos e modernizações menos complexas. O Consultor Técnico Comercial auxilia na solução de eventuais problemas, Captação de Clientes, participação em concorrências de modernização.


Quais os Requisitos?


  • Superior em andamento / concluído (desejável Adm, Mkt ou Engª).
  • Interno: Mínimo de 1 ano como Técnico AA Pleno / Sênior
  • Irá atuar na Barra.


O que você ganha com isso?

  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Previdência Privada e Cooperativa de Crédito;
  • Vale Refeição (com possibilidade de desmembramento parcial para Vale Alimentação) ou Restaurante no local – de acordo com a localidade de atuação;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Plano de saúde, Assistência Odontológica, Assistência Farmácia
  • Seguro de Vida e de Acidentes Pessoais;
  • Eleve-se (Atendimento e apoio de profissionais especializados em Psicologia, Jurídico, Assistência Social, Nutrição, Educação Física, Fisioterapia, Educação Financeira, Pedagogia, e Assessoria PET);
  • Licença maternidade/paternidade estendida;
  • Cesta de Natal e Brinquedo para filhos de até 11 anos;
  • Plataforma de aprendizagem online de idiomas gratuita;
  • Parceria de descontos com universidades e outras instituições de ensino.
  • Wellhub.


Nós Elevamos... Sua carreira


Faça parte da nossa equipe e nos ajude a melhorar a qualidade de vida e a impulsionar a inovação, elevando o nível de segurança e sustentabilidade. Valorizamos suas diversas habilidades e perspectivas, pois juntos moldamos as cidades sustentáveis de hoje e de amanhã.


Você está pronto para embarcar em uma nova jornada? Junte-se ao #TeamSchindler! Descubra mais em nosso site de carreiras.

No Grupo Schindler, valorizamos a inclusão e a diversidade, e praticamos a equidade para criar oportunidades iguais para todos. Esforçamo-nos para que todos os candidatos qualificados recebam consideração para emprego independentemente de idade, raça, origem étnica, cor, filiação religiosa, filiação sindical, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, estado civil, origem nacional, nacionalidade, genética e saúde ou deficiência.


Serão aceitas apenas candidaturas feitas pelo(a) proprio(a) candidato(a). Candidaturas realizadas por teceiros, agências de recrutamento ou headhunters, não serão aceitas.

title: Auxiliar de Loja | Castanheira, Belém | Natura
description:
Você já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa que se preocupa com a sustentabilidade? Você gosta de criar relações, desenvolver equipe e de gerar boas experiências? Você já se imaginou em um lugar que valoriza a diversidade? Você gosta de perfumes, cosméticos e maquiagem? Se você respondeu sim para todas essas perguntas, estamos procurando VOCÊ!



Isso é a NATURA!


Atualmente temos mais de 1000 lojas abertas em todo Brasil e levamos nossa brasilidade para 9 países! O varejo é um canal que gera experimentação dos diversos produtos e estabelece relações entre a Natura e nossos clientes.


VIVA SUA BELEZA e venha trabalhar conosco! Te convidamos a avaliar essa oportunidade:


Endereço: BR-316, Km 01 - Castanheira, Belém - PA,


O que estamos buscando?

Procuramos profissionais com conhecimento em produtos e serviços, além de habilidades sólidas em organização e gestão de tarefas, para colaborar com a equipe de loja.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Profissional que será o responsável pela organização do estoque da loja;
  • Fazer a separação de produtos a fim de atender os pedidos captados, de forma rápida e com qualidade (sem falta, danos e/ou excessos);
  • Obedecer todos os regulamentos e procedimentos de trabalho da empresa;
  • Garantir a organização dos produtos nas prateleiras;
  • Limpeza das prateleiras;
  • Apoio no recebimento de materiais diversos;
  • Apoio na separação e armazenamento dos produtos no estoque;
  • Montagem de kits de produtos diversos;
  • Montagem das caixas/embalagens para a confecção de kits diversos;
  • Apoio na precificação dos produtos;
  • É responsável por cumprir com as políticas, regras e normas de Segurança do Trabalho e Saúde ocupacional de seu local ou processo de trabalho.



Quais os requisitos?

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Experiência em atendimento ao público;
  • Experiência no segmento de beleza (será um diferencial).


Nossos Benefícios

  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Transporte
  • Assistência médica + seguro de vida
  • Cartão Farmácia
  • Vale-presente Natura no seu aniversário
  • Produtos Natura com 40% off

title: Laboratory Specialist (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are recruiting for professionals working with providers of laboratory instruments and diagnostics for a paid consultancy session on an online research study.



Qualifications:

  • Brazil-based
  • Need to have influence for purchases of and/or personally uses Flow Cytometry Instruments, Flow Cytometry Reagents, Microbiology Instruments, and/or Molecular Diagnostics Instruments
  • The purpose of this study is to better understand professionals’ experiences and perceptions of providers of laboratory instruments and diagnostics.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an online questionnaire, lasting for 20 minutes.


Compensation package - R$ 295 for 20 minutes online

We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are recruiting for professionals working with providers of laboratory instruments and diagnostics for a paid consultancy session on an online research study.



Qualifications:

  • Brazil-based
  • Need to have influence for purchases of and/or personally uses Flow Cytometry Instruments, Flow Cytometry Reagents, Microbiology Instruments, and/or Molecular Diagnostics Instruments
  • The purpose of this study is to better understand professionals’ experiences and perceptions of providers of laboratory instruments and diagnostics.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an online questionnaire, lasting for 20 minutes.


Compensation package - R$ 295 for 20 minutes online

title: Consultor ABAP/EWM
description:
Desenvolvedor ABAP/EWM (Expertise Tecnica em EWM)


Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor ABAP experiente, com forte expertise técnica em EWM p ara uma posição 100% remota - necessário inglês avançado/fluente .


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, construir, aprimorar e dar suporte aos processos SAP EWM utilizando ABAP.
  • Desenvolver e manter menus RF , interfaces com dispositivos RF e Adobe Forms .
  • Colaborar com equipes funcionais e técnicas para garantir soluções EWM de alta qualidade.
  • Identificar, solucionar e resolver problemas técnicos complexos com postura proativa e foco em resolução.
  • Comunicar-se de forma eficaz com stakeholders em inglês.


Requisitos

  • E xperiência como Desenvolvedor ABAP Senior/Expert, com foco em desenvolvimento técnico EWM.
  • Sólida compreensão dos processos EWM e capacidade de projetá-los ou aprimorá-los.
  • Experiência em mais de uma implementação completa (full cycle).
  • Experiência prática e aprofundada em: (Desenvolvimento de RF-menu, Interfaces com dispositivos RF e Adobe Forms)
  • Forte capacidade analítica, resolução de problemas e boa comunicação.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar cobrindo principalmente o horário das 12h às 18/19h EST .
  • Inglês avaçado/fluente (falado e escrito).


Detalhes do Contrato

  • Tipo: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)
  • Duração: Mínimo de 5 meses , com possibilidade de extensão por até 1 ano *Renovável
  • Local: Remoto - Disponibilidade imediata para inicio frente aprovação .

title: Solution Architect (Modern Work)
description:

In this role you will leverage your technical expertise in Microsoft Teams and Viva to deliver proactive services and workshops to premier enterprise customers in Brazil.

  • Design and development experience in major Viva components

  • Experience in customer and stakeholder management

We look forward to receiving your applications.


Successful candidates will be contacted within 2 weeks of applying

title: Senior Software Engineer IV
description:
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer IV for a 100% Remote, 6 month +, 1099 contract

No 3rd Party C2Cs Please.


Location: Brazil, South America (work remote supporting US based client/project)

Employment Type: Contract Work, 40 hours weekly


100% Requirement: Must have good verbal & written communication (English)


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer IV to lead technical initiatives, tackle complex engineering challenges, and provide mentorship to the team. This role requires expertise in software development, leadership in driving projects, and the ability to design scalable solutions. The ideal candidate will manage the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive project success.


In This Role You Will:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and deliver project requirements
  • Ensure engineering best practices are followed throughout development
  • Contribute to system architecture and design discussions


Core Competencies for success:

  • Expertise in at least one critical system/service and recognized leadership in that area
  • Proven track record of delivering high-quality software solutions
  • Ability to estimate project costs and resource needs
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills
  • Commitment to continuous learning and innovation


Credentials and Experience:

  • Proficiency in backend development using Python, SQL, MongoDB and AWS
  • Preference for engineers with full-stack proficiency, particularly in Vue.js
  • Extensive experience designing and implementing scalable software solutions
  • Strong expertise in software development methodologies and best practices
  • Experience leading teams and managing software projects

title: Desenvolvedor Mobile Pleno
description:
Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver aplicativos para: Android e iOS, máquinas POS de cartão de crédito (Android) e totens

Construir interfaces e fluxos alinhados às jornadas de compra, check-in e operação presencial.

Implementar funcionalidades com React Native, Kotlin e Swift.

Implementar e manter WebViews para reaproveitamento de fluxos web.

Integrar com APIs REST e WebSockets.

Realizar integrações com periféricos, incluindo: Impressoras térmicas (Bluetooth / USB / rede)

Máquinas POS de cartão de crédito Scanners (código de barras / QR Code) Tecnologia NFC — pulseiras e cartões (cashless)

Colaborar com backend, QA e produto para definições técnicas e funcionais. Garantir performance, segurança e estabilidade dos apps.

Participar da publicação e atualização nas lojas (Google Play / App Store). Versionar código, revisar PRs e manter padrões técnicos.

Criar, evoluir e manter pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions) para build, testes e distribuição.

Requisitos:

Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento mobile para Android e iOS. Conhecimento em React Native.

Conhecimento em Kotlin (Android) e Swift (iOS).

Integração com APIs REST.

Experiência com WebView para fluxos híbridos.

Familiaridade com arquitetura (ex.: MVVM, Clean Architecture).

Experiência com Git + GitHub (branching, pull requests, code review). Experiência com CI/CD (GitHub Actions).

Publicação e manutenção de apps nas lojas.


Diferenciais:

Experiência com: Máquinas POS de cartão de crédito (Android)

NFC para pulseiras e cartões (cashless)

Impressoras térmicas (Bluetooth / USB / rede)

Desenvolvimento para totens

Conhecimento de integrações com gateways de pagamento.

Experiência com WebSockets.

Firebase (Auth, Messaging, Crashlytics).

Uso de IA para acelerar desenvolvimento e QA.

title: Vendedor
description:
Vaga: Vendedor Home Office – Comissionado


Sobre a empresa


A DragoSYS é especializada em criação de sites acessíveis e funcionais para pequenos negócios, ajudando empreendedores a aumentar vendas e presença online. Nosso foco é qualidade, eficiência e resultados reais para os clientes. Estamos em expansão e buscamos vendedores comprometidos, profissionais e com iniciativa para atuar remotamente, representando a marca com excelência.


⸻


Benefícios e oportunidades

• Comissão por venda: R$30 por site vendido, com meta de 30 vendas semanais, potencial de quase R$4.000/mês.

• Bônus por desempenho extra: oportunidade de ganhos adicionais para vendedores que superarem a meta.

• Trabalho 100% home office, com horário flexível e sem custo inicial.

• Leads fornecidos pela empresa: você foca apenas em fechar vendas, sem precisar prospectar.

• Oportunidade de crescimento: vendedores consistentes podem receber mais leads e metas maiores, aumentando significativamente a renda .


⸻


Qualificações e habilidades desejadas

• Experiência prévia em vendas online ou atendimento comercial via WhatsApp/telefone.

• Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com postura profissional.

• Organização e disciplina para atingir metas diárias e registrar resultados.

• Capacidade de negociação e persuasão, mantendo abordagem ética e profissional.

• Resiliência e proatividade, com habilidade para lidar com rejeição e manter foco em resultados.

• Obrigatório possuir WhatsApp Business e atuar em nome da DragoSYS.


⸻


Processo de seleção

1. Candidatura: entre em contato via WhatsApp ou e-mail.

2. Teste inicial: contato com 10–20 leads fornecidos para demonstrar habilidade de abordagem e fechamento.

3. Treinamento rápido: apresentação do script de vendas e postura profissional da DragoSYS.

4. Início das atividades: metas diárias acompanhadas via planilha ou CRM.

5. Avaliação contínua: feedback semanal e possibilidade de aumento de leads e ganhos conforme desempenho.

title: Sr Java Developer
description:
Senior Java Developer – Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Java Developer to join our team and lead the modernization of our existing applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Java development, hands-on experience with modern frameworks, and the ability to guide the migration of legacy systems to contemporary architectures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the migration of legacy applications (currently built on Struts 2.0 ) to modern frameworks and architectures.
  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable applications using Java , Spring Framework , and Microservices .
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements, propose solutions, and deliver high-quality software.
  • Participate in the full SDLC including analysis, design, coding, testing, and deployment.
  • Ensure code quality through best practices such as code reviews, unit testing, and adherence to design patterns.
  • Support and troubleshoot production issues, ensuring application stability and performance.
  • Work on frontend components as needed using React or Angular (added advantage).
  • Leverage Python skills for automation, data processing, or backend scripting tasks (bonus).
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to improving overall team capability and processes.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6–10+ years of experience in Java/J2EE development .
  • Strong hands-on experience in Spring Boot , Spring MVC , Microservices , REST APIs, and related technologies.
  • Experience with Struts 2.0 or legacy frameworks and proven ability to migrate systems to modern architectures.
  • Good understanding of software design principles, OOP, design patterns , and best coding practices.
  • Experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and DevOps concepts.
  • Working knowledge of React or Angular (good to have).
  • Basic to intermediate experience with Python (bonus).

description:
Job Title: Technical Program Manager/Delivery Manager

Duration: Fulltime with CriticalRiver

Location: Brazil/Costa Rica

Need to support PST timings

Job Profile:

  • Manage delivery for our key customers across all the technological tracks
  • Manage and lead teams across technologies, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
  • Ensure regular updates to customer stake holders sent through WSRs
  • Conduct MBRs and QBRs
  • Achieve high customer delight


Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and budget by working with technology teams.

  • Manage and lead teams across technologies, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
  • Work with PMO and ensure quality control procedures to ensure high standards in the delivery.
  • Act as a delivery point of contact for Customer, Understanding the Customer, managing expectations and ensuring highest customer satisfaction.
  • Service/Project Review meetings with Customer and Management
  • Adopt customer specific processes and methodologies.
  • Proactively Identify, evaluate, and mitigate project risks effectively.
  • Ensure that the project teams meet SLAs and avoid service credits / penalties.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance project delivery processes, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Utilize effective conflict resolution and negotiation tactics to maintain high-level performance within service teams.
  • Establish and monitor KRAs and KPIs as performance metrics for team members.
  • Support hiring the right resources for various tracks as the roles get identified by working with the TAG teams
  • Ensure SOWs are signed and Invoices cleared on-time by working with finance teams and the customer stakeholders
  • Continuously work with individual members in the project teams and ensure their contributions are made visible to customer in terms of activities/stories/Jira Tickets as applicable on a weekly basis and obtain continuous feedback on the performance of the teams and course correct as needed appropriately.
  • Work with customer stake holders, identify the opportunities, proactively create proposals with efforts, solutioning and financials


Skills:

  • Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Proven experience in software development project management, must have worked with onshore/Nearshore/offshore model. Open to be flexible to be able to speak to teams in different time zones.
  • Exceptional communication, interpersonal, thought leadership skills with the ability to effectively engage with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills.
  • Familiarity with various project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, ITIL).
  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to manage complex project challenges

title: Chef Tournant
description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
  • Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
  • Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
  • Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
  • Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
  • Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
  • Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
  • Responsible for follow-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
  • Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
  • Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
  • Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
  • Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within his section.
  • Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
  • Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food & Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
  • Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.


QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION

  • A minimum of 5 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef Tournant (shipboard experience preferred).
  • A culinary school degree is required.
  • Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
  • Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
  • Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
  • Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
  • Intermediate computer software skills required.
  • Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries and corrections.
  • Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Since 1995, Red Oak Technologies has been a trusted partner in the tech industry, delivering innovative talent solutions that drive progress. We specialize in quickly acquiring and efficiently matching top-tier professional talent with clients in immediate need of highly skilled contract, permanent or project management based resources.


Data Analyst, Sales Finance


Location: LATAM- BRAZIL OR MEXICO

Hours: 40 hours per week

Duration: 1 year contract


About the Role and Team

Our Client is seeking a Data Analyst (Contractor) to support the Sales Finance team. This role will help accelerate analysis, reporting, and business insights by partnering closely with the Senior Manager of Sales Finance Analytics. You will work on a mix of ad hoc analysis, deep dive projects, dashboard and BI development, and light data engineering in support of Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Product teams.


This is a hands-on execution role focused on delivering high quality analytical work that helps the company move faster. The ideal candidate has moderate SQL skills, strong business acumen, and the ability to learn quickly in a dynamic environment.


Projects and Initiatives You Will Support

  • Run ad hoc analysis to answer business questions related to customer behavior, product usage, sales performance, and financial trends
  • Support deep dive projects such as weighted pipeline evaluation, consumption reporting, sales attainment analysis, and LTV to CAC modeling
  • Build and maintain draft BI dashboards in Tableau or similar tools
  • Write SQL queries to pull, clean, and transform data in Snowflake
  • Support the development of repeatable data models for financial and operational metrics
  • Draft summaries and written analysis that highlight insights and trends
  • Partner with internal teams to clarify metric definitions and ensure consistency across reporting
  • Document logic, definitions, and assumptions to support long term reuse
  • You Will Be a Great Addition to the Team If You Have


Minimum Qualifications:


  • 1 to 3 years of experience in data analytics, BI, or a related field
  • Moderate SQL experience with a willingness to learn and improve
  • Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI
  • Strong analytical reasoning and the ability to connect data to business concepts
  • Clear written communication skills and the ability to summarize findings
  • Comfortable working independently and managing priorities in an async environment
  • High attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem solving


Extra skills that stand out:


  • A builder mentality with interest in creating small tools or solutions to improve workflows. Curiosity and experimentation with AI tools is a plus.
  • Experience working with SaaS metrics such as ARR, NRR, churn, pipeline, product usage, or LTV to CAC
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses
  • Experience supporting finance, revenue, or business operations teams
  • Knowledge of Python or scripting for data automation is helpful but not required
  • Familiarity with data modeling or ELT concepts
  • Contract Structure

description:
Since 1995, Red Oak Technologies has been a trusted partner in the tech industry, delivering innovative talent solutions that drive progress. We specialize in quickly acquiring and efficiently matching top-tier professional talent with clients in immediate need of highly skilled contract, permanent or project management based resources.


Data Analyst, Sales Finance


Location: LATAM- BRAZIL OR MEXICO

Hours: 40 hours per week

Duration: 1 year contract


About the Role and Team

Our Client is seeking a Data Analyst (Contractor) to support the Sales Finance team. This role will help accelerate analysis, reporting, and business insights by partnering closely with the Senior Manager of Sales Finance Analytics. You will work on a mix of ad hoc analysis, deep dive projects, dashboard and BI development, and light data engineering in support of Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Product teams.


This is a hands-on execution role focused on delivering high quality analytical work that helps the company move faster. The ideal candidate has moderate SQL skills, strong business acumen, and the ability to learn quickly in a dynamic environment.


Projects and Initiatives You Will Support

  • Run ad hoc analysis to answer business questions related to customer behavior, product usage, sales performance, and financial trends
  • Support deep dive projects such as weighted pipeline evaluation, consumption reporting, sales attainment analysis, and LTV to CAC modeling
  • Build and maintain draft BI dashboards in Tableau or similar tools
  • Write SQL queries to pull, clean, and transform data in Snowflake
  • Support the development of repeatable data models for financial and operational metrics
  • Draft summaries and written analysis that highlight insights and trends
  • Partner with internal teams to clarify metric definitions and ensure consistency across reporting
  • Document logic, definitions, and assumptions to support long term reuse
  • You Will Be a Great Addition to the Team If You Have


Minimum Qualifications:


  • 1 to 3 years of experience in data analytics, BI, or a related field
  • Moderate SQL experience with a willingness to learn and improve
  • Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI
  • Strong analytical reasoning and the ability to connect data to business concepts
  • Clear written communication skills and the ability to summarize findings
  • Comfortable working independently and managing priorities in an async environment
  • High attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem solving


Extra skills that stand out:


  • A builder mentality with interest in creating small tools or solutions to improve workflows. Curiosity and experimentation with AI tools is a plus.
  • Experience working with SaaS metrics such as ARR, NRR, churn, pipeline, product usage, or LTV to CAC
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses
  • Experience supporting finance, revenue, or business operations teams
  • Knowledge of Python or scripting for data automation is helpful but not required
  • Familiarity with data modeling or ELT concepts
  • Contract Structure



Red Oak Technologies is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. See what it’s like to be at the top; connect with one of our recruiters and apply today.


Let us help you find your next career opportunity! JOIN RED OAK TECHNOLOGIES!


Learn what it’s like to be a Red Oak Consultant!


Red Oak Five (Core Values): Relationships First | Exceptional Quality and Service | Unwavering Integrity and Trust | Be Easy To Do Business With | Respect Everyone

title: Editor de vídeo
description:
A Artha Growth Studio está em expansão e buscamos um(a) Editor(a) de Vídeos para integrar nosso time.


Procuramos alguém com ritmo, visão estratégica de conteúdo e capacidade de transformar ideias em vídeos que geram retenção, autoridade e crescimento.


A Artha Growth Studio trabalha com diferentes formatos de conteúdo, de vídeos dinâmicos para redes sociais até criativos avançados, materiais corporativos e projetos para o mercado imobiliário.


Por isso, buscamos um(a) Editor(a) de Vídeo que possa atuar no estilo de edição em que mais se identifica .


Você não precisa dominar tudo.


Queremos pessoas que sejam muito boas no que já fazem bem .


Sobre o trabalho

Você poderá atuar em diferentes tipos de projetos, como:

• Edição dinâmica de vídeos para YouTube, Reels, Shorts e TikTok.

• Criativos de marketing, VSL e materiais comerciais.

• Vídeos corporativos e institucionais.

• Projetos com motion, VFX ou 3D, especialmente em conteúdos imobiliários e empreendimentos.


Responsabilidades

• Edição de vídeos curtos e longos para redes sociais.

• Criação de cortes dinâmicos, legendas, transições e ritmo engajador.

• Adaptação de um vídeo-base para múltiplos formatos.

• Participação na construção da linha editorial e evolução do estilo visual da agência.

• Manter a qualidade e consistência do material da agência.

• Organização de arquivos, prazos e entregas.

• Comunicação clara com o time.

• Entrega consistente dentro dos prazos combinados.


Requisitos

• Experiência no estilo de edição que deseja atuar.

• Portfólio obrigatório.

• Domínio da ferramenta que você usa.

• Capacidade de criar vídeos com alta retenção (timing, cortes, velocidade).

• Vontade real de crescer junto com a agência.


Inglês e Espanhol intermediário é diferencial (trabalhamos também com clientes internacionais).


Diferenciais

• Motion básico.

• Experiência com anúncios ou VSL.

• Experiência com 3D, CGI ou VFX.


Formato de trabalho

• PJ

• Remoto

• Remuneração por demanda ou mensal (dependendo da carga de projetos).

title: Android Developer
description:
Open Video project is focused on OTT platform development for one of the largest North American TV providers. We are looking for Senior Software Developer who will be working on software development for the client hardware platform based on Android OS.


Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for development of embedded software engineering projects for Set-Top Box hardware using the latest software solutions and techniques. Work as an individual contributor while providing technical guidance to development and integration projects. Coordinate development process of Set-Top Box projects for various hardware platforms. Establish operational monitoring processes and dashboards using IT operations analytics and log analysis tools. Interact with systems analysts, software architects, developers and project management teams. Administer and prevent problems using issue tracking, team collaboration and planning tools. Prepare technical hand off and training documentation.
  • Experience required:
  • * Agile methodology
  • * Android development; Android TV is a plus. AOSP development is a plus
  • * Programming Languages: Java, Kotlin


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • * Agile methodology
  • * Android development
  • * Programming Languages: Java, Kotlin


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • * AOSP
  • * Android TV


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (Python + React)
description:
About The Company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About The Opportunity

We're seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our Supply Chain & Operations technology team. This is a high-impact role focused on rapid application development for business-critical systems that power clients' global supply chain, logistics, and operational excellence.

You'll work embedded within a dynamic, hybrid team of internal engineers and external collaborators, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, UX designers, and technical leads to deliver full-stack solutions that solve real operational challenges. This role requires someone who goes beyond just writing code; you'll need to understand user needs, contribute to requirements analysis, and bring strong product thinking to ensure we're building the right solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop full-stack web applications using React/TypeScript (frontend) and Python/FastAPI (backend) to address operational challenges in supply chain, logistics, and planning systems.
  • Build and optimize solutions for large-scale relational datasets with MySQL or PostgreSQL, ensuring query performance and data integrity.
  • Deploy and maintain containerized applications on Kubernetes, implementing infrastructure updates, connectivity enhancements, and cloud platform improvements.
  • Integrate with third-party systems, external APIs, workflow platforms, and enterprise services (IAM, authentication, etc.) while upholding security and privacy standards.
  • Apply DevSecOps practices throughout the development lifecycle, focusing on security by design, automated testing, and quality gates.
  • Support and maintain production systems, including triaging and resolving bugs, implementing enhancements, and executing planned infrastructure upgrades.


Required Qualifications

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Proven capabilities in backend development, focusing on Python with FastAPI in the backend , including RESTful API design and asynchronous programming patterns
  • Advanced proficiency in React and TypeScript for modern frontend development, Single Page Applications (SPA), including state management, performance optimization, and accessible UI design
  • Expertise in Vue.js, PHP/Symfony, and databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL).
  • Disciplined approach to code quality and testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) with experience in Git


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

We're seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our Supply Chain & Operations technology team. This is a high-impact role focused on rapid application development for business-critical systems that power clients' global supply chain, logistics, and operational excellence.

You'll work embedded within a dynamic, hybrid team of internal engineers and external collaborators, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, UX designers, and technical leads to deliver full-stack solutions that solve real operational challenges. This role requires someone who goes beyond just writing code; you'll need to understand user needs, contribute to requirements analysis, and bring strong product thinking to ensure we're building the right solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop full-stack web applications using React/TypeScript (frontend) and Python/FastAPI (backend) to address operational challenges in supply chain, logistics, and planning systems.
  • Build and optimize solutions for large-scale relational datasets with MySQL or PostgreSQL, ensuring query performance and data integrity.
  • Deploy and maintain containerized applications on Kubernetes, implementing infrastructure updates, connectivity enhancements, and cloud platform improvements.
  • Integrate with third-party systems, external APIs, workflow platforms, and enterprise services (IAM, authentication, etc.) while upholding security and privacy standards.
  • Apply DevSecOps practices throughout the development lifecycle, focusing on security by design, automated testing, and quality gates.
  • Support and maintain production systems, including triaging and resolving bugs, implementing enhancements, and executing planned infrastructure upgrades.


Required Qualifications

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Proven capabilities in backend development, focusing on Python with FastAPI in the backend , including RESTful API design and asynchronous programming patterns
  • Advanced proficiency in React and TypeScript for modern frontend development, Single Page Applications (SPA), including state management, performance optimization, and accessible UI design
  • Expertise in Vue.js, PHP/Symfony, and databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL).
  • Disciplined approach to code quality and testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) with experience in Git


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Software Engineer (Murex)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Murex Developer to join our team, supporting strategic initiatives within the financial sector. The role begins as fully remote , with the expectation of relocation to Portugal after an agreed transition period. You will work closely with multicultural teams, contributing to the enhancement and stability of the Murex MX.3 platform.


Responsibilities

  • Develop, customize, and maintain components and configurations within Murex MX.3 , across modules such as Trading, Risk, Collateral, and Back Office.
  • Build and enhance workflows, simulation views, formulas, and MxML Exchange interfaces.
  • Design and maintain integrations with internal and external systems (REST, SOAP, MQ, APIs, ETL, etc.).
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents, ensuring system stability and performance.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, QA, and project teams to gather requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Support release cycles, functional testing, regression testing, and UAT phases.
  • Maintain compliance with technical standards, documentation, and governance processes.


Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Murex MX.3 (configuration, development, or integration).
  • Solid knowledge of Datamart, MxML Exchange, Workflows, Simulation Views , and other core Murex components.
  • Strong programming skills: Java, SQL, Shell Script , and ideally Python.
  • Experience with system integrations, middleware, or messaging platforms.
  • Good understanding of financial instruments, especially derivatives (FX, IRD, Fixed Income, Equities, Commodities).
  • Strong English communication skills.
  • Willingness and eligibility to relocate to Portugal after the initial remote period.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience working with major banks or large international financial institutions.
  • Knowledge of DevOps methodologies and tools (CI/CD, Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum .
  • Murex certifications or experience with MX.2 → MX.3 migrations.

Desired Profile

  • Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving ability.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in remote and multicultural environments.
  • Proactive, organized, detail-oriented, and capable of working under pressure.
  • Motivated to engage in a long-term role involving relocation.

What We Offer

  • Remote work during the initial phase.
  • Support and guidance for future relocation to Portugal .
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Opportunity to work on complex, high-impact financial systems.
  • Multicultural work environment and professional growth opportunities.

description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga:

  • Apoiar o time tecnicamente com os projetos, garantindo a qualidade técnica e a eficácia do desenvolvimento;
  • Manutenção nas funcionalidades existentes;
  • Documentação técnica dentro do escopo do time;
  • Análise e correção de problemas em ambiente produtivo;
  • Colaboração com o time na definição de novas abordagens ou tecnologias.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com Java (11+);
  • Conhecimento em Spring e Spring Boot;
  • Conhecimento em Ruby;
  • APIs e integrações;
  • Experiência em RESTful APIs;
  • Conhecimento em cloud computing;
  • Conhecimento em AWS;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança da informação;
  • Autenticação, Autorização e Criptografia;
  • Prevenção de ataques.


Diferenciais:

  • Familiaridade com frameworks ágeis (Scrum e Kanban);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas Atlassian: JIRA e Confluence;
  • Experiência React e React Native;
  • Experiência JavaScript (Node.js);
  • Axway - API Gateway;
  • Conhecimento em Continuous Integration: Git, Jenkins e Docker;
  • Mensageria;
  • Bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.



Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;


Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

title: SAP EPPM C4P
description:
SAP EPPM & Resource Management Consultant (Public Cloud)


Location: Lisbon (Hybrid)

Contract Type: 1-year B2B, with strong possibility of permanent placement

Language: English (mandatory) — French is an added value


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced SAP EPPM & Resource Management Consultant with strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud , particularly in processes related to C4P (Customer for Projects) . You will play a key role in supporting and optimizing project management, resource planning, and project-related operational processes in a dynamic, international environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support implementations and enhancements in SAP EPPM on S/4HANA Public Cloud
  • Configure and optimize Resource Management , workforce planning, and project staffing flows
  • Integrate project operations with C4P and related Public Cloud modules
  • Analyse business requirements and translate them into efficient SAP Public Cloud solutions
  • Provide functional expertise, best practices, documentation, and user training
  • Ensure alignment between business stakeholders and technical teams
  • Support testing cycles, UAT sessions, and go-live/hypercare phases
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of project portfolio management processes

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience as SAP consultant in EPPM , Resource Management , or Project Systems (PS)
  • Solid knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud configuration
  • Experience with C4P / Project Collaboration / SAP Public Cloud for Projects is a strong plus
  • Understanding of project financials, resource scheduling, and project lifecycle processes
  • Ability to work in international teams; excellent communication skills in English
  • French language skills are an added advantage

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on leading-edge SAP Public Cloud solutions
  • Hybrid working model in Lisbon
  • 1-year B2B contract with the advantage of progressing to a stable permanent position
  • Collaborative, international work environment

description:
Professional competence (Job related) 专业能力 （与工作相关）:

  • 3年及以上食品配料或添加剂行业销售经验，有亲水胶体相关从业经验者优先；
  • 熟悉亲水胶体（卡拉胶、琼脂、复配食品添加剂等）产品应用技术，具备与客户针对亲水胶体应用技术方面进行沟通交流；
  • 语言：除本国母语外，要求英语流利，中文沟通者更佳；
  • 良好的书面及口头表达能力，熟练使用常用办公软件。
  • 有较强的商务谈判能力


  • At least 3 years and above sales experiences in food ingredients or food additives industry,working experience in hydrocolloid industry is preferred.
  • Be familiar with the application technology of hydrocolloid, and have the ability to develop project with customer by using carrageenan, agar, konjac gum and blended solutions.

（3）Language: In addition to native language, English fluency is required, Chinese communicator is preferred

（4）Good written and oral communication ability, proficiency with office software.

（5）Good commercial negotiation ability


主要职责：

  • 负责市场开发、客户开发和维护和销售管理等工作。
  • 负责所属区域的产品宣传、推广和销售,完成销售的任务指标。
  • 制定自己的销售计划，并按计划拜访客户和开发新客户。
  • 搜集与寻找客户资料，建立客户档案。
  • 做好销售合同的签订、履行与管理等相关工作，以及协调处理各类市场问题。

(1) Responsible for market development, customer development maintenance and sales management.

(2) Responsible for product publicity, promotion and sales in the region, and complete the sales target.

(3) Make your own sales plan, visit customers and develop new customers as planned.

(4) Collect and find customer information, and establish customer files.

(5) Well management of sales contract signing, implementation, and with good coordination and deal with various market issues.

(6) Have good teamwork spirit, and effectively use internal and external resources to achieve sales targets.

title: Integration Architect - Java
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar desde a macroestimativa/T-Shirt até o fim da Sprint 0/Grooming;
  • Garantir a entrega dos artefatos previstos no fluxo de trabalho;
  • Governança e catálogo;
  • Zelar pela governança de arquitetura, alinhada às diretrizes corporativas;
  • Realizar discovery de APIs e manter o Portal de Assets atualizado;
  • Gestão no Jira e visibilidade;
  • Registrar e acompanhar atividades no Jira;
  • Anexar entregáveis nas etapas correspondentes;
  • Apontar impedimentos para refletir no Kanban e nos indicadores;
  • Qualidade e sustentação;
  • Participar, quando necessário, de validações e war rooms para assegurar a qualidade das entregas;
  • Planejamento e estimativas;
  • Participar do plano de projeto com o líder de portfólio (LP);
  • Pontuar demandas, mapear premissas e contribuir para as definições técnicas;
  • Documentação para desenvolvimento;
  • Criar as informações técnicas dos tickets de desenvolvimento de fábrica (documento de entrada para desenvolvimento);
  • Em alguns casos, o LP poderá criar os tickets com informações básicas;
  • Entregas de integração: macroestimativas, DATI, mapeamentos de dados, OpenAPI/Swagger, documentação de capacidade de infraestrutura;
  • Entender a solução e produzir a documentação necessária para viabilizar o desenvolvimento;
  • Apoiar o time de negócios em refinamentos e reuniões.


Requisitos e qualificações


Requisitos obrigatórios;

  • Arquitetura Hexagonal (mandatório);
  • Java SE/EE;
  • Java+Spring;
  • Integrações SOAP e REST;
  • Diagramação no C4 Model;
  • OpenAPI v3;
  • API Gateway (Axway Amplify), microserviços, APIs;
  • Segurança (OAM);
  • Cloud Azure;
  • Camunda;
  • Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA);


Desejáveis;

  • Construção de arquiteturas escaláveis;
  • Reutilização de código, clean code e componentização;
  • Ferramentas de versionamento de código;
  • Metodologias ágeis;
  • Domínio do ciclo completo de desenvolvimento: planejamento, entrega, melhoria contínua e acompanhamento de impacto;
  • Observabilidade e métricas de aplicação/infra: análise de logs, monitoramento, analytics, entre outros;
  • Testes: unitários, de integração e funcionais; Ferramentas de integração contínua (CI).

  • Entregas de integração: macroestimativas, DATI, mapeamentos de dados, OpenAPI/Swagger, documentação de capacidade de infraestrutura;
  • Entender a solução e produzir a documentação necessária para viabilizar o desenvolvimento;
  • Apoiar o time de negócios em refinamentos e reuniões.


Requisitos e qualificações


Requisitos obrigatórios;

  • Arquitetura Hexagonal (mandatório);
  • Java SE/EE;
  • Java+Spring;
  • Integrações SOAP e REST;
  • Diagramação no C4 Model;
  • OpenAPI v3;
  • API Gateway (Axway Amplify), microserviços, APIs;
  • Segurança (OAM);
  • Cloud Azure;
  • Camunda;
  • Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA);


Desejáveis;

  • Construção de arquiteturas escaláveis;
  • Reutilização de código, clean code e componentização;
  • Ferramentas de versionamento de código;
  • Metodologias ágeis;
  • Domínio do ciclo completo de desenvolvimento: planejamento, entrega, melhoria contínua e acompanhamento de impacto;
  • Observabilidade e métricas de aplicação/infra: análise de logs, monitoramento, analytics, entre outros;
  • Testes: unitários, de integração e funcionais; Ferramentas de integração contínua (CI).

title: Analista de Service Desk (Inglês Avançado) - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Analista de Service Desk (Inglês Avançado) - Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você :

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

  • Atuará como Analista de Suporte no Service Desk para atendimento de clientes globais em inglês no modelo Follow The Sun (FTS).
  • Escala 12x36 (9h as 21h).


O que esperamos de você:

Indispensável:

  • Experiência prévia em Service Desk / Suporte Técnico N1.
  • Conhecimento em: Windows 10/11, contas de usuário, permissões e troubleshooting básico, Active Directory (reset de senha, desbloqueio, grupos).
  • Pacote Office / M365 (Ex: Configuração de Outlook e etc).
  • VPN, redes básicas e conectividade.
  • Hardware e periféricos.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de ticket (preferencialmente ServiceNow).
  • Inglês avançado (comunicação com equipes globais).


Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com ambiente global 24x7 / FTS.
  • Conhecimento em ITIL Foundation.
  • Experiência em suporte a múltiplos clientes (MSP).
  • Espanhol Intermediário


Formação Obrigatória:

Cursando Graduação na área de TI, Graduado ou Ensino Médio Técnico (TI) completo.

title: Auxiliar de Loja - Shopping Campo Grande | Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência
description:
Esta é uma posição afirmativa para Inclusão de Pessoas com Deficiência na Natura – parte do nosso Compromisso Com a Vida e com a nossa sociedade. Caso você não se autodeclare como parte desse grupo, recomendamos que dê uma olhada nas nossas outras posições. Para nós, diversidade, equidade e inclusão são dimensões do mesmo esforço para transformar o mundo e nos transformar; para ter equipes que sejam reflexo das realidades dos países onde operamos e nos aproximar dos nossos consultores, representantes e consumidores.


Você já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa que se preocupa com a sustentabilidade? Você gosta de criar relações, desenvolver equipe e de gerar boas experiências? Você já se imaginou em um lugar que valoriza a diversidade? Você gosta de perfumes, cosméticos e maquiagem? Se você respondeu sim para todas essas perguntas, estamos procurando VOCÊ!



Isso é a NATURA!


Atualmente temos mais de 1000 lojas abertas em todo Brasil e levamos nossa brasilidade para 9 países! O varejo é um canal que gera experimentação dos diversos produtos e estabelece relações entre a Natura e nossos clientes.


VIVA SUA BELEZA e venha trabalhar conosco! Te convidamos a avaliar essa oportunidade:


Auxiliar de Loja - Shopping Campo Grande | (Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência)


Endereço: Av. Afonso Pena, 4909 - Santa Fé, Campo Grande - MS,


O que estamos buscando?

Procuramos profissionais com conhecimento em produtos e serviços, além de habilidades sólidas em organização e gestão de tarefas, para colaborar com a equipe de loja.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Profissional que será o responsável pela organização do estoque da loja;
  • Fazer a separação de produtos a fim de atender os pedidos captados, de forma rápida e com qualidade (sem falta, danos e/ou excessos);
  • Obedecer todos os regulamentos e procedimentos de trabalho da empresa;
  • Garantir a organização dos produtos nas prateleiras;
  • Limpeza das prateleiras;
  • Apoio no recebimento de materiais diversos;
  • Apoio na separação e armazenamento dos produtos no estoque;
  • Montagem de kits de produtos diversos;
  • Montagem das caixas/embalagens para a confecção de kits diversos;
  • Apoio na precificação dos produtos;
  • É responsável por cumprir com as políticas, regras e normas de Segurança do Trabalho e Saúde ocupacional de seu local ou processo de trabalho.


Quais os requisitos?

  • Ensino médio completo.


Nossos Benefícios

  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Transporte
  • Assistência médica + seguro de vida
  • Cartão Farmácia
  • Vale-presente Natura no seu aniversário
  • Produtos Natura com 40% off

title: JDE Functional Finance Lead
description:
We’re looking for an experienced JDE Functional Finance Lead to join our team and play a key role in supporting and optimizing JD Edwards Financial processes. This role is ideal for a hands-on finance systems professional with strong functional expertise in GL, AP, Tax, and regulatory compliance .


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and support JD Edwards (JDE) Financial modules , including GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, and Tax
  • Partner with Finance, Tax, Audit, and IT teams to ensure accurate and compliant financial processes
  • Translate business requirements into functional system solutions
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities
  • Ensure compliance with financial regulations, tax rules, and internal controls
  • Lead testing (UAT), enhancements, and system improvements
  • Provide functional guidance, training, and ongoing support to finance users
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and automate financial processes


Required Skills and Experience:

  • Strong functional experience with JD Edwards Financials
  • Proven expertise in General Ledger, Accounts Payable, and Tax
  • Solid understanding of financial regulations and compliance
  • Experience leading or supporting JDE implementations or upgrades
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with technical and business teams
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Information Systems
  • Experience in multi-entity or multi-country financial environments
  • Prior experience as a functional lead or subject matter expert

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML)
description:
About the company:


Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

Remote : Contract


The Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML – Pricing) plays a crucial role in the development and deployment of innovative machine learning solutions for retail pricing that includes understanding various customer and operational business constraints and translating complex real-world problems into well-defined mathematical objectives


✅ Minimum Requirements: - PhD or Masters degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operation Research or related field - 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning, 3+ years experience in building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in production environments at scale

- Deep understanding of ML best practices (A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, feature engineering etc), algorithms/techniques (gradient boosting, deep neural networks, optimization, regularization), and experiment design

- Proficiency with scientific libraries in Python (numpy, pandas, polars) and Machine Learning tools and frameworks (ScikitLearn, Tensorflow, Keras, PyTorch)

- Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large scale datasets

- Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Apache Kafka, Spark)

- Experience with cloud technologies AWS, GCP or Azure - Fluency in Python, SQL

Remote : Contract


The Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML – Pricing) plays a crucial role in the development and deployment of innovative machine learning solutions for retail pricing that includes understanding various customer and operational business constraints and translating complex real-world problems into well-defined mathematical objectives


✅ Minimum Requirements: - PhD or Masters degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operation Research or related field - 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning, 3+ years experience in building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in production environments at scale

- Proficiency with scientific libraries in Python (numpy, pandas, polars) and Machine Learning tools and frameworks (ScikitLearn, Tensorflow, Keras, PyTorch)

- Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large scale datasets

- Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Apache Kafka, Spark)

- Experience with cloud technologies AWS, GCP or Azure - Fluency in Python, SQL

title: Analista em Power BI Sênior
description:
Objetivo da Posição


Atuar como referência técnica em Power BI , sendo responsável por análises avançadas de dados, modelagem analítica e desenvolvimento de dashboards estratégicos , garantindo confiabilidade, governança e clareza na entrega de insights para apoio à tomada de decisão. O profissional terá papel ativo na liderança técnica de demandas complexas e na orientação do time de dados.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Conduzir análises avançadas de dados , transformando informações em insights estratégicos para o negócio.
  • Desenvolver e manter dashboards e relatórios em Power BI , com foco em performance, usabilidade e storytelling.
  • Criar e otimizar modelos de dados analíticos , aplicando boas práticas de modelagem e relacionamento.
  • Implementar DAX avançado para cálculos complexos, indicadores e métricas de negócio.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando Power Query (M) e Dataflows .
  • Atuar na otimização de performance de relatórios, modelos e datasets.
  • Realizar integrações com bancos de dados e APIs , garantindo consistência e qualidade das informações.
  • Garantir governança, segurança, parametrização e versionamento no Power BI Service.
  • Apoiar o time como referência técnica , revisando soluções, orientando boas práticas e liderando demandas de maior complexidade.
  • Participar de iniciativas de ETL/ELT , colaborando com times de engenharia e arquitetura de dados.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Domínio avançado de Power BI .
  • Experiência comprovada com:
  • DAX avançado
  • Power Query / M
  • Dataflows
  • Modelagem de dados analíticos
  • Otimização de performance
  • Experiência sólida com SQL , incluindo consultas complexas, joins, CTEs e funções analíticas.
  • Conhecimento em integrações com múltiplas fontes de dados , bancos relacionais e APIs.
  • Vivência com governança, segurança (RLS), parametrização e gestão de ambientes no Power BI Service.
  • Experiência em processos de ETL/ELT .


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimentos em arquitetura de dados e ambientes em nuvem, como:
  • Azure
  • Data Lake
  • Synapse Analytics ou soluções similares.

title: Senior Business Manager
description:
1. Be responsible for the development of the local non-ferrous mineral market in the target country (products include but are not limited to: copper, lead, zinc, lithium, nickel, etc.), contact and visit customers of mining resources, factory customers and customers of export business, and maintain customer relationships regularly;


2. Assist the company in maintaining relationships with existing clients, handling, reporting and resolving unexpected issues during business advancement.


3. Actively maintain communication and coordination with local ports and relevant government departments to ensure the smooth operation of business.


4. Have a global perspective to empower overseas business;


5. Other tasks assigned by leaders.



Application requirements


Full-time bachelor's degree is required. Major is not limited. Those who can communicate in Chinese with the local language of the target country are preferred.


2. Candidates with more than three years of relevant experience in international trade and familiarity with the overseas market conditions of mineral products are preferred.


3. Outgoing personality, with a strong sense of personal achievement and self-motivation, and a strong sense of career.

title: ServiceNow Developer
description:
Apricot Jam


Apricot Jam is a US based consulting and technology company working with Fortune 500 and large enterprise clients worldwide. We design and deliver next generation enterprise solutions combining ServiceNow, AI driven automation, and strong engineering practices.


Our teams operate across Europe the US and Asia, working in a culture that values ownership, curiosity, and continuous growth. We believe great software is built by people who care deeply about quality, collaboration, and impact.


Role Overview


We are looking for skilled ServiceNow Developers to join our growing delivery team. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building modern enterprise applications and want to work across advanced ServiceNow capabilities including UI Builder, AI Agent Studio, App Engine, and ERP focused integrations.


You will work closely with solution architects, functional consultants, and client stakeholders to design and implement scalable solutions on the ServiceNow platform. The more of the skills below you bring, the more impact you can have.


What You Will Do


• Design configure and develop custom solutions on the ServiceNow platform

• Build modern user experiences using UI Builder and Next Experience

• Develop applications using App Engine including ERP related use cases

• Configure and extend workflows using Flow Designer and platform automation

• Implement integrations using IntegrationHub REST and Zero Copy Connector patterns

• Work with AI Agent Studio and Now Assist related capabilities where applicable

• Translate business requirements into clean scalable technical solutions

• Participate in technical workshops solution reviews and demos

• Collaborate with global teams across Europe and the US

• Contribute to best practices performance optimization and platform governance


Required and Desired Skills


• 3 plus years of hands on ServiceNow development experience

• Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal

• Strong JavaScript skills including client and server side scripting

• Experience with one or more of the following is highly valued

• UI Builder and custom workspace development

• AI Agent Studio or Now Assist related configurations

• App Engine Studio and custom application development

• ERP related ServiceNow use cases

• ERP Canvas and Zero Copy Connector experience

• Solid understanding of ServiceNow data models security and performance

• Experience with Flow Designer IntegrationHub and APIs

• Ability to work in a client facing environment


Certifications are a strong plus

• CSA CAD

• CIS certifications ITSM CSM HRSD ITAM or App Engine


Why Join Apricot Jam


• Work on complex high impact ServiceNow implementations for US enterprise clients

• Be part of a senior globally distributed ServiceNow team

• Exposure to cutting edge ServiceNow capabilities including AI and ERP integrations

• Support for certifications learning and career growth

• Competitive compensation based on experience and contribution

• A people first culture built on trust autonomy and collaboration

Our teams operate across Europe the US and Asia, working in a culture that values ownership, curiosity, and continuous growth. We believe great software is built by people who care deeply about quality, collaboration, and impact.


Role Overview


We are looking for skilled ServiceNow Developers to join our growing delivery team. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building modern enterprise applications and want to work across advanced ServiceNow capabilities including UI Builder, AI Agent Studio, App Engine, and ERP focused integrations.


You will work closely with solution architects, functional consultants, and client stakeholders to design and implement scalable solutions on the ServiceNow platform. The more of the skills below you bring, the more impact you can have.


What You Will Do


• Design configure and develop custom solutions on the ServiceNow platform

• Build modern user experiences using UI Builder and Next Experience

• Develop applications using App Engine including ERP related use cases

• Configure and extend workflows using Flow Designer and platform automation

• Implement integrations using IntegrationHub REST and Zero Copy Connector patterns

• Work with AI Agent Studio and Now Assist related capabilities where applicable

• Translate business requirements into clean scalable technical solutions

• Participate in technical workshops solution reviews and demos

• Collaborate with global teams across Europe and the US

• Contribute to best practices performance optimization and platform governance


Required and Desired Skills


• 3 plus years of hands on ServiceNow development experience

• Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal

• Strong JavaScript skills including client and server side scripting

• Experience with one or more of the following is highly valued

• UI Builder and custom workspace development

• AI Agent Studio or Now Assist related configurations

• App Engine Studio and custom application development

• ERP related ServiceNow use cases

• ERP Canvas and Zero Copy Connector experience

• Solid understanding of ServiceNow data models security and performance

• Experience with Flow Designer IntegrationHub and APIs

• Ability to work in a client facing environment


Certifications are a strong plus

• CSA CAD

• CIS certifications ITSM CSM HRSD ITAM or App Engine


Why Join Apricot Jam


• Work on complex high impact ServiceNow implementations for US enterprise clients

• Be part of a senior globally distributed ServiceNow team

• Exposure to cutting edge ServiceNow capabilities including AI and ERP integrations

• Support for certifications learning and career growth

• Competitive compensation based on experience and contribution

• A people first culture built on trust autonomy and collaboration

title: Analista GIS Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga


  • Analisar, planejar e executar as atividades da área de Customer Success da Diretoria de Experiência do Cliente, com foco na satisfação e sucesso dos clientes.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Ajudar o cliente a alcançar os objetivos idealizados com a compra de nossa plataforma;
  • Gerir o Onboarding;
  • Upsell & Cross Sell;
  • Reuniões de tomada de decisão e projetos;
  • Propor as melhores soluções aos clientes, sejam mudanças ou manutenções;
  • Follow ups frequentes sobre o andamento do projeto dos clientes;
  • Avaliar indicadores de performance e resultados dos clientes;
  • Colher feedbacks sobre o produto ou serviço;
  • Elaborar e apresentar reports para que o cliente fique ciente de onde está e para onde vai;
  • Nutrir o cliente com informações sobre a plataforma de forma estratégica;
  • Gerenciar conflitos de expectativa, solucionando eventuais problemas e acionando as áreas envolvidas, incluindo à Qualidade Imagem para melhorias contínuas de nossos processos;
  • Garantir a utilização completa da plataforma de acordo com os objetivos do cliente;
  • Fazer a ponte entre os feedbacks dos clientes e operação/comercial/marketing/fornecedores.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduado em Ciências da Terra.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Atendimento a clientes internos e externos;
  • Conceitos básicos das metodológicas de Customer Experience e Customer Success;
  • Conhecimentos em GIS;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados;
  • Vivência em projetos;
  • Conhecimento em TI (Banco de Dados e automações com Python);
  • Conhecimento sólido em ArcGIS (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise e aplicativos como Survey, Dashboards etc.);
  • Experiência prévia em empresas de recursos naturais ou geomarketing (ambiental, mineração, óleo e gás).


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;
  • Inglês Intermediário/Avançado;
  • Power BI;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão dos produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem.
