title: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Technical Customer Support (TCS) Representative with 2+ years of Level 1 support experience, preferably in a doctor's office, veterinary clinic, hospital, or similar healthcare environment. You will use your critical thinking skills to listen to and understand customer needs, offering timely solutions that drive value and customer satisfaction. You will be involved in all aspects of support, including product demonstrations and customer education.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Perform core functions of technical support, configuration tasks, and scheduling
  • Maintain high reliability in terms of on-time attendance and availability in assigned channels per shift schedule
  • Provide a timely response and resolution to all inbound customer support (phone, chats, and emails) to understand customer needs and feedback
  • Demonstrate understanding of the client's core products and everyday use cases within the veterinary industry, engaging with customers effectively on their issues
  • Identify the root cause of customer issues, understand the steps to replicate and solve the problem within the client's means, and escalate when not
  • Stay updated on product knowledge to help build and curate knowledge articles
  • Deliver excellent customer experience to clinics and pet owners
  • Ensure root cause and solution are provided consistently
  • Provide all-channel support during designated shift hours:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 AM - 4 PM CT (preferred) or 9 AM - 6 PM CT
  • Provide live channel (phone, chat) support during periodic flex times (1 to 2 times per month):
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 - 8 AM CT or 5 - 6 PM CT
  • Fridays
  • 1 - 2 PM CT or 3 - 4 PM CT


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2+ years of Level 1 support for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product
  • Experience with Zendesk Talk, Messaging, and Support or similar platforms
  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting clinician environments, including veterinarian clinics, doctor offices, or hospitals


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Field Support Engineer
description:
Location: Brazil | Supporting CALA

Company : Intellicene

Here’s the thing - This role sits right between deep technical work and real customer ownership. You’ll be hands-on with Intellicene’s software and hardware in the field, while also acting as a trusted advisor to customers across the CALA region.

What you’ll do

• Install, upgrade, troubleshoot, and maintain Intellicene’s enterprise software and related hardware

• Support video management, situational awareness, and dispatch solutions — onsite and remotely

• Own technical issues end-to-end and coordinate with internal teams to resolve them fast

• Travel to customer sites (up to 75%) for project deployment and delivering hands-on training

• Manage the customer lifecycle from onboarding to long-term success

• Drive product adoption through training, usage analysis, and practical guidance

• Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders, from technical teams to executives

• Identify upsell and expansion opportunities and work closely with Sales

What you bring

• Fluent Portuguese, Spanish, and English

• Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or equivalent experience

• Experience in physical security/video surveillance environments

• Strong background supporting enterprise software in LAN/WAN environments

• Solid networking knowledge (TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, Multicast)

• Experience with Windows Server, virtualization, MS SQL Server, and hardware (RAID, NAS/SAN)

• Customer-facing mindset with clear communication and presentation skills

• Experience with tools like Salesforce, Zoho, Aha, and Microsoft 365

• Willingness to travel frequently and handle shifting priorities

Nice to have

• 5+ years in customer-facing technical roles (support, professional services, pre/post-sales)

• Relevant certifications (Cisco, MCSE, Project Management)

• Experience reading SOWs and presenting to executive audiences

If you enjoy being close to the technology and even closer to the customer, this role is for you.

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA Developer
description:
This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

Cost and capacity management in Azure 

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

Cost and capacity management in Azure 

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points

  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Consultor de SAP sênior
description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar como parceiro da Brivia.

Somos um ecossistema especializado na transformação de marcas, ajudando nossos clientes a superar desafios em transformação digital, tecnologia e marketing. Para isso, buscamos constantemente expandir nossas capacidades, contando com os melhores especialistas em diversas áreas.

O Brivia_Group quer contar com o seu talento para fortalecer ainda mais nosso ecossistema de transformação digital!


Descrição da Oportunidade:

Buscamos um Consultor Sênior SAP CO & PS para atuar em um ambiente de alta complexidade, com foco em sustentação (L2/L3), resolução de incidentes, melhorias contínuas e pequenas evoluções nos módulos Controlling (CO) e Project System (PS). O profissional apoiará processos críticos de negócio, especialmente fechamento mensal, controles de custo e integração com áreas financeiras e operacionais.


Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar configuração e suportar os módulos SAP CO e PS.
  • Atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes dentro do SLA.
  • Conduzir atividades relacionadas ao fechamento contábil e financeiro.
  • Desenvolver especificações funcionais para melhorias, relatórios e integrações.
  • Troubleshooting em CCA, IO, PCA, CO-PA, Product Costing, WBS, redes e liquidações.
  • Colaborar com equipes FI, MM, PP e SD garantindo integração dos fluxos de custeio.
  • Executar análise de causa raiz e propor ações preventivas.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com SAP CO & PS.
  • Graduação em Contabilidade, Finanças, Administração ou TI/Sistemas da Informação.
  • Domínio de processos de custeio industrial, overhead, centros de custo e centros de lucro.
  • Conhecimento de integração FI/MM/PP.
  • Vivência com S/4HANA (forte diferencial).
  • Inglês fluente.


Diferenciais:

  • Atuação prévia em projetos SAP de grande porte, multinacionais ou AMS.


Informações Adicionais.

  • Contratação no modelo PJ (CNPJ ativo necessário)
  • Equipamento próprio
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Junte-se a um ecossistema dinâmico e faça parte da revolução do mercado!

title: Consultor Senior Valuation
description:
Junte-se a Forvis Mazars

Se você quer uma carreira repleta de oportunidades, desafios, crescimento contínuo e um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e inovador, venha para a Forvis Mazars.

Sobre Nós

Somos uma das 10 maiores empresas em prestação de serviços, reconhecidos pela nossa excelência e capacidade de fornecer uma experiência única aos nossos clientes e equipes. Acreditamos que o crescimento sustentável é alcançado através do investimento no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e novas tecnologias.

Como uma empresa global mantemos alto nível de excelência garantindo uma experiência única através de qualificação, trabalho integrado, tecnologia e desenvolvimento contínuo de nosso time.

Sua Jornada Conosco

Aqui, você terá a chance de trabalhar com um time de alto nível atendendo clientes globais, construindo conexões valiosas e evoluindo suas habilidades e competências. Oferecemos programas de treinamento focados no seu crescimento e qualificação, programas de desenvolvimento & performance e um ambiente que promove a excelência e aprendizado. Além do trabalho, cuidamos do seu bem-estar, garantindo um ambiente acolhedor, cultivando a riqueza das relações interpessoais.

Responsabilidades


  • Conduzir frentes de trabalho em projetos de valuation, estruturando modelos, definindo premissas e aplicando metodologias adequadas, sempre em alinhamento com a liderança.
  • Participar de reuniões com clientes para validar premissas e esclarecer aspectos financeiros, estratégicos e regulatórios.
  • Realizar análises críticas sobre riscos de avaliação, assegurando consistência com CPCs e IFRS.
  • Apoiar na elaboração de laudos técnicos e apresentações executivas para suporte a decisões estratégicas.
  • Revisar modelos desenvolvidos por consultores juniores e plenos, fornecendo orientação técnica e feedback construtivo.
  • Colaborar com times de auditoria, consultoria e M&A durante todo o processo de avaliação.


Requisitos


  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em valuation, modelagem econômico-financeira e projetos de M&A.
  • Conhecimento avançado em CPC 01 e CPC 15.
  • Excel avançado


Benefícios

  • Serviço de telemedicina;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Canal de apoio psicológico;
  • Convênio com o SESC;
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação (Cartão Flash) – flexibilidade para o seu dia a dia;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica (Amil);
  • Assistência Odontológica (Amil);
  • Seguro de vida (SulAmérica)
  • Descontos e, incentivos educacionais em diversas instituições.

Se você se identificou com o nosso jeito de ser, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Aqui teremos diversas oportunidades e desafios para que você possa contribuir e se desenvolver em conjunto conosco.

title: Junior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: SAP Developer
description:
SAP ABAP Consultant

100% REMOTE

Type - PJ


Must haves are:


  • CDS Views and AMDP
  • Working with Master Data, Transactional PO, sales order data and truly understand how to create these tables. The whole scope is they will be building extract plans for this new system to run.


Core Responsibilities:

  • Build inbound and outbound interfaces that map SAP data to Relex standard interface specifications.
  • Support one-time historical data loads (3 years of transactional and master data).
  • Set up and maintain daily data feeds (materials, locations, inventory balances, open orders, BOM/routings, delivery schedules, etc.).
  • Ensure accuracy and consistency of SAP master and transactional data entering the Relex platform.
  • Troubleshoot edge cases where SAP structures don’t align with Relex requirements.
  • Support UAT and early-use testing as Relex starts consuming live data.
  • CDS Views experience is required.


Who We Are

Dexian Brasil, launched in 2023, has a global presence and brings nearly 30 years of experience through its legacy companies, primarily from the combination of DISYS and Signature Consultants. We began operations in Brazil in 2007 as DISYS and, since then, have earned the trust of more than 60 clients across different sectors of the economy.

As Dexian, we have become one of the largest providers of staffing solutions, IT solutions, and workforce augmentation. We are leading the industry by delivering unique services that combine global scale, full-service projects, and tactical agility to modernize hiring models. We support our clients in finding the best way to address their talent gaps, helping to support their digital transformation processes.

We have offices strategically located in four major cities: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ), and São Paulo (SP). This allows us to stay close to our clients and consultants. We are also a Minority Owner Company and are proud to have been born from diversity.

What to Expect From Us

People are at the center of our strategy and represent our greatest asset. We are committed to attracting and retaining top talent and building real, lifelong connections. That’s why we act as a bridge between highly qualified professionals and consistent, prosperous opportunities.

We believe that bringing the right talent, technology, and organizations together helps unlock transformative results and achieve new levels of success for both the clients we serve and the consultants we hire. To achieve this, we are guided by five core values: Integrity, Transparency, Authenticity, Ingenuity, and Empathy .

Dexian is committed to corporate social responsibility and invests in programs that support diversity and inclusion.

If you share these values, this is the place for you!

title: Profissional Back End – .NET Pleno
description:
Código da vaga: 55483


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera em desenvolvimento, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos por #feras com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência sólida com .NET em suas versões antigas e atuais.
  • Experiência com AWS e suas principais ferramentas.
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e tecnologias de mensageria como RabbitMQ.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, como SQL Server e MySQL, e NoSQL como MongoDB e outros.
  • Experiência em processos de Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua (CI/CD).
  • Conhecimento em versionamento de código utilizando Git.


- Diferenciais:

  • Certificações AWS.
  • Experiência com outras plataformas de cloud, como Azure ou GCP.
  • Conhecimento em containers, como Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Vivência com sistemas de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Professor de alemão
description:
Oportunidade para um(a) professora(a) de alemão, que busca trabalhar de forma remota e flexível, se desprendendo do método tradicional de ensino e impactando positivamente na vida de centenas de alunos e alunas.


Buscamos um profissional paciente, responsável e proativo. Não é necessário ter experiência.


Tipo de contratação: PJ;

Nível de proficiência: B2 ou acima.

Horário: 20 horas semanais.

Salário: R$2.500 mensais.

Local: Remoto.


Atividades principais:

• Aulas de Conversação e Plantões de Dúvidas, conforme metodologia do curso.


Requisitos Necessários:

• Proficiência de Nível B2 ou acima.

• Experiência intermediária com pacote Office.

• Agilidade;

• Boa comunicação.

• Paciência;


Habilidades Diferenciais (mas não obrigatórias):

• Graduado(a) ou graduando(a) em Letras.

• Experiência com viagens/intercâmbio para países falantes de alemão;

• Experiência com produção de conteúdo para redes sociais.


Quem Somos:

A GC Ensino é uma empresa especializada em lançamentos digitais de infoprodutos, idealizadora da escola de alemão "Missão Alemão" e do curso "Programa Deutsch Pro".


Isso significa que transformamos vidas através do conhecimento!


Nosso papel é promover a educação e impactar positivamente milhares de pessoas ao redor do mundo, através do idioma alemão. E tudo isso utilizando uma ferramenta que mudou a forma com que nós, seres humanos, nos comunicamos: a internet!

title: AI Automation Specialist | Ecommerce (Full-time Remote, BR)
description:
Carepod is a growing premium humidifier brand operating in the US, Canada, and Australia . We’re looking for an AI Automation Specialist to eliminate manual work and build smart, reliable workflows across the business.



What You’ll Do


  • Build AI-powered automations for marketing, operation, CS, and reporting system throughout company
  • Connect tools like Shopify, Asana, Google Workspace, Zendesk
  • Design workflows using Zapier / Make / n8n + LLMs like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, etc
  • Identify inefficiencies and turn them into systems



What We’re Looking For


  • 3+ years in automation / ops / systems roles
  • Hands-on experience with no-code / low-code tools
  • Strong business process thinking
  • Clear English communication
  • Bonus: ecommerce, Python, security-minded builds

title: Service Delivery Manager – Enterprise Support (Remote)
description:
About the company

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.

Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


About the role

We’re looking for an experienced Service Delivery Manager to take ownership of our service operations:

  • SLAs and incident processes
  • on‑call and skills coverage
  • SOPs and first‑line/SRE enablement
  • configuration management
  • SLA metrics and reporting
  • and coordination between customers and our engineering teams.

This is a hands‑on role , not a pure governance role. You will be close to real incidents, engineers, and customers and you’ll be expected to bring in practices you’ve already used successfully in previous service or managed‑services environments.


What you’ll do1. Service operations, on‑call & incidents
  • Design and maintain an on‑call and coverage plan that ensures all critical skills are available when needed (initially weekdays, evolving to full 24/7 where required).
  • Own the incident management process for your accounts: priorities, roles, communication cadence, escalations, and post‑incident reviews.
  • Define and monitor key service metrics (e.g., MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, backlog health) and drive improvements based on them.
  • Act as incident lead / coordinator during major incidents, keeping engineers focused and customers informed.


2. SOPs, runbooks & first‑line enablement
  • Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, and triage guides for SRE engineers, covering common incident types and operational tasks.
  • Train and coach first‑line/SRE teams so they can confidently handle initial triage, basic troubleshooting, and clear communication , escalating only when needed.
  • Continuously refine documentation based on real incident experience and feedback.


3. Configuration management & readiness
  • Establish and run a configuration management process that keeps track of each customer’s environment (platforms in use, clusters, regions, configs, access, monitoring, key contacts).
  • Proactively close information gaps by working directly with customers and engineers.
  • Ensure configuration information is available and trustworthy during incidents and for onboarding new engineers.


4. Customer communication & governance
  • Be the primary operational contact for a set of enterprise customers.
  • Lead regular service reviews and status calls , presenting SLA performance, key incidents, risks, and improvement actions.
  • Present and agree on the incident management process with customers (channels, priorities, escalation paths, expectations).
  • Work closely with Account Management / Sales on renewals, expansions, and expectation management.


5. Commercial & delivery management
  • Clarify what is in scope vs. out of scope and work with customers and Sales to shape paid change requests when additional work is needed.
  • Monitor effort vs. contract , help protect margins, and flag risks early (under‑scoped contracts, chronic over‑use, under‑utilized capacity).
  • Work in a matrix environment , coordinating with different technical teams (e.g., database engineering, DevOps, SRE) to staff and deliver engagements effectively.


6. Onboarding & training
  • Design and maintain onboarding paths for new engineers joining support/delivery (shadowing, training on SOPs, environment overviews, “certification” on certain incident types).
  • Ensure new team members reach a productive, independent state quickly and safely.


What success looks like in 6–12 months
  • On‑call coverage is clear, predictable, and sustainable ; engineers know when they’re on and what’s expected.
  • First‑line/SREs handle a meaningful share of incidents without escalation , using well‑maintained runbooks.
  • You can open a customer’s configuration, see an accurate picture, and use it during incidents and planning.
  • SLA and incident metrics are tracked, reported, and discussed regularly with customers and internally.
  • Customers have a clear understanding of how incidents are handled and feel confident in the process.
  • New engineers ramp up faster thanks to structured onboarding and training.


You’ll be a great fit if you have
  • 5+ years in a Service Delivery, Managed Services, IT Operations, or Enterprise Support role serving external customers (not only internal IT).
  • Experience with 24/7 or extended‑hours operations , including on‑call or follow‑the‑sun setups.
  • Hands‑on experience with incident management and ITSM practices (incident/problem/change), ideally in an ITIL‑inspired environment.
  • A track record of creating or improving SOPs/runbooks and training first‑line / SRE teams.
  • Experience maintaining configuration / environment data for customer systems.
  • Comfort discussing technical topics with engineers (cloud, distributed systems, data platforms) and explaining them in clear business terms to customers.
  • Experience in commercial delivery : scope boundaries, change requests, effort vs. revenue, working alongside Sales / Account Management.
  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken.


Nice to have

  • Background with data, analytics, or streaming platforms (e.g., Druid, Kafka, Flink, StarRocks, ClickHouse, TiDB, Hadoop, cloud data warehouses).
  • Experience working in small, fast‑moving, remote teams.


Location & working style
  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.
  • We are flexible on contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Descrição da Função


Esta é uma função remota em tempo integral para Analista de Dados . O Analista de Dados será responsável por coletar, organizar, analisar e interpretar grandes conjuntos de dados para identificar padrões e tendências. A coleta ocorrerá em bancos de dados próprios bem como a busca de dados em bases externas, de forma automatizada e também de forma manual (que pode vir a ser automatizada, fazendo parte da função). Também irá desenvolver e manter painéis de dados (dashboards), criar modelos de dados e auxiliar na melhoria dos processos de tomada de decisão do negócio, alimentar e criar planilhas. Além disso, a função inclui a preparação de relatórios e a apresentação clara de insights para as partes interessadas.

Qualificações

  • Proficiência em Análise de Dados e compreensão abrangente do trabalho com grandes volumes de dados
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e capacidade de identificar tendências e insights acionáveis
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Estatística para analisar dados e gerar conclusões precisas
  • Habilidades de comunicação eficazes para apresentar insights e colaborar com equipes multifuncionais
  • Experiência com Modelagem de Dados e criação de visualizações eficazes
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas e softwares estatísticos como SQL, Python, R é desejável
  • Conhecimento em Excel avançado é necessário
  • Conhecimento básico de Ingles é necessário.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente em um ambiente remoto em tempo integral
  • Graduação em Estatística, Ciência de Dados, Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada é altamente desejável

title: Investment Banking Jr. Associate
description:
2024 Atlas Technology Boutique Investment Bank of the Year and VentureBeat Top 5 Tech M&A Firm, Ignatious, is seeking top tier candidates to expand its global junior execution team.


Role Description


In this role, you will work directly with some of the most experienced and highly renowned bankers in the world’s most important and disruptive sector — technology — supporting and executing high-profile M&A and private capital raise transactions. You will be a key part of small client teams delivering the highest quality work product and outcomes to some of the most prominent technology companies in the world.  We are not a 9-to-5 firm, we work late hours and weekends.  If you are motivated, curious by nature and aspire to crush it in an ambitious setting next to other high performers seeking to build a world class investment bank, we want to hear from you.


This is a front-office position that is fully remote, and requires close collaboration with our U.S., Caribbean, LatAm, and other team members across the globe. The right candidate will have a relentless work ethic, strong analytical and communication skills, and a passion for delivering precision work and unmatched client service in a high-pressure, entrepreneurial environment. 


Core Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English
  • +2 years of experience in front-office investment banking
  • Excellent analytical, financial modeling and critical thinking skills
  • Strong work ethic communication, presentation, problem-solving and negotiation skills
  • Strong PowerPoint Presentation skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented with a track record of achieving goals
  • Bachelors and or/master's degree in an analytical field from a reputed college
  • Affinity for current events, critical issues, and relevant news


Job Responsibilities


Advanced Financial Modeling & Analysis

  • Analyze and organize significant amounts of unstructured data to develop a coherent financial understanding of clients, the mechanics of their businesses and their historical performance 
  • Build from scratch and refine complex financial models (3-statement, DCF, LBO, accretion/dilution, etc.) to assess various capital structures, debt instruments, and valuation scenarios.
  • Develop strategic recommendations and support for creative transaction structures


Deal Execution Support

  • Collaborate directly with clients, advisors, and internal senior partners to provide regular updates on deal progress, outstanding issues, and strategic recommendations.
  • Coordinate due diligence processes (legal, financial, operational), monitoring timelines, and handling data flow among stakeholders.
  • Prepare transaction documentation including confidentiality agreements, term sheets, and final marketing materials for prospective investors or acquirers.


Pitchbook & Presentation Development

  • Craft high-impact pitch materials and management presentations, presenting complex financial data in an accessible and visually engaging format.
  • Continuously update standard client-facing materials with new market insights, recent transaction benchmarks, and emerging sector opportunities.


Market & Industry Research

  • Conduct in-depth industry analyses, monitoring key competitive trends, macroeconomic factors, and regulatory developments that may impact deal opportunities.


Mentorship & Team Coordination

  • Oversee and guide junior analysts in research, modeling best practices, and quality control, ensuring consistency and accuracy in all deliverables.
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture by sharing knowledge, providing constructive feedback, and encouraging continuous learning.


Process Optimization & Best Practices

  • Evaluate current deal execution procedures, identifying process gaps and implementing improvements to streamline workflows.
  • Contribute to the creation and refinement of standardized templates, database resources, and knowledge-sharing initiatives to enhance team efficiency.


Compensation: 

  • Competitive Base Salary & Variable Compensation 
  • Significant Investment In Training, Mentorship and Professional Development 


Company Description

Specializing in M&A and private capital raise expertise, Ignatious helps technology companies achieve extraordinary financial outcomes in various verticals including AI/Artificial Intelligence (longstanding practice), Software, Mobility/Transportation, Consumer Internet, Health Care IT, FoodTech, AdTech/Marketing Tech, FinTech/Web 3.0, GovTech, and Prop Tech.


Ignatious is founded and led by Storm Duncan, former Global Head of Technology M&A at Credit Suisse and Jefferies. Storm has advised many of the most iconic companies and defining transactions in the technology sector including Google / YouTube / DoubleClick, Tencent / Universal Music Group, Microsoft, Apple / Drive.ai, Tinder / Match, Oracle / Sun / MySQL / RightNow, Uber / Careem, Lyft, AMD / NexGen, and AOL / DARPANET, amongst many others. His leadership is supported by a team of highly accomplished Senior Partners who previously led U.S. investment banking teams at J.P. Morgan, Jefferies, Deutsche Bank and Credit Suisse prior to joining Ignatious. 


If you are interested, please send CV to and / or apply on LinkedIn to ensure that you are considered for this role.

title: PLM Engineer III
description:
PLM Engineer III @ Remote


Job Summary:

In this role, the PLM Engineer III will serve as a technical expert in the areas of infrastructure related to manufacturing information systems. The engineer will identify methods and architect solutions to provide a high level of service to end-users of the application(s). This role will help build out, maintain, and troubleshoot a rapidly expanding application system and its infrastructure. The Engineer will work closely with other engineers, analysts, and leadership to obtain regular feedback on design and execution. Additionally, the Engineer will provide periodic operational support and maintenance of the manufacturing systems.


Essential Duties:

• Responsible for the maintenance, optimization, troubleshooting, upgrades, installation and documentation of infrastructure related to Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems which

includes PLM database management, project management systems, CAD and PDM systems,

• Administration of new and existing technologies, including the design, documentation, install, configuration, maintenance, integration, and testing related systems

• Leads collaboratively with business customers on hardware, middleware, and application requirements.

• Leads with vendors, engineers, analysts, and leadership to ensure the integrity of databases, application software and data

• Performs regular system monitoring, verifying the integrity, health and availability of all systems and key processes, reviewing application and system logs, and ensuring completion of scheduled jobs

• Leads problem-solving efforts regarding system and service matters and if necessary, facilitates support with outside personnel, organizations, and/or vendors

• Monitor tech-industry trends, and brings new ideas and innovative solutions

• Develop new deliverables as needed based on operational requirements and following best practices for documentation and delivery

• Analyzes data to drive decision making and recommendations.

• Configure and deploy devices and peripherals as necessary

• Resolves issues, problems and questions on-site assigned from a ticketing system


Qualifications: Requirements - Required and/or Preferred


Education:

• Basic: Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, or similar discipline, and/or equivalent related work experience

• Preferred: PLM Certification


Essential Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience with ARAS (PLM tool) and SolidWorks (CAD system)

• Minimum of 4+ years of hands-on experience in a factory or enterprise setting

title: Business Data Analyst
description:
Role: Business Data Analyst

Remote – Brazil

Contract

Required:

Combination of IT and business experiences. Business focus areas include Supply Chain.


Description:

  • Work directly with the product managers & product owners for Business Requirements Gathering & documentation
  • Be part of Agile Product Delivery
  • Good to have Power BI, Snowflake, SAP ERP and SAP HANA, SQL knowledge
  • Leverage reporting Tools for Analysis like Office, Power BI etc
  • Develop roadmaps to drive the company forward
  • Act as a liaison across all areas such as business units, information technology, and outside customers by investigating relevant information and creating recommendations
  • Continuously refine Product Backlog Items together with the Scrum Team and other subject matter experts to ensure the team understands those items to the level needed for them to estimate and plan to work during sprint planning
  • Established background in launching software/solutions or services in partnership with business and engineering teams.
  • High degree of proficiency in wireframes, prototyping, iterative development, understanding of agile principles.
  • Ability to inspire a team to act as a small business jointly accountable for its product.
  • Experience successfully driving end-to-end delivery of highly innovative products, including a wide variety of mechanisms (e.g., digital core, dashboards, APIs, cloud, e-commerce, real-time alerts, artificial intelligence)
  • Outstanding organizational, communication, relationship-building, and collaboration skills at all levels
  • Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills, prioritization and time management skills
  • Understanding of cloud data lakes and data warehouse systems (systems and data)
  • Familiarity with MS Power BI for Business reporting and Self-service
  • Prior experience working for a global, highly matrixed, Consumer Packaged Goods company, preferably in the Supply Chain domains
  • Knowledge of the CPG market, industry trends, and customer needs to help inform the product vision and roadmap.
  • Experience creating automated data quality management rules

title: Financial Modelling Analyst
description:
About CELA


CELA – Clean Energy Latin America is a leading financial and strategic advisory firm focused on energy transition in Latin America.


With over 12 years of experience, we advise companies and investors across reflective strategy, energy, fundraising, project finance, and M&A, covering several sector such as Renewables, Hydrogen, Batteries, Biofuels, etc.


Our work supports the development of sustainable energy solutions with real impact across the region.

Learn more:


The Role


We are looking for a Financial Modelling Analyst to join our consulting team and support investment analysis and financial modelling for energy transition projects and companies.

This role offers:

  • Exposure to real investment decisions in renewable energy
  • Direct interaction with clients, investors, and senior consultants
  • A fast-paced, analytical, and impact-driven environment


Key Responsibilities

  • Build and review financial models for: Company and project valuation, Financial due diligence, Feasibility studies and Equity and debt fundraising
  • Analyze operational metrics of energy projects (tariffs, capacity, generation, performance)
  • Evaluate financial indicators, including: Enterprise Value (EV), Net Present Value (NPV), Internal Rate of Return (IRR) and others
  • Support CELA’s consulting team with financial analysis and modelling tools
  • Contribute to high-quality client deliverables and internal decision-making


Profile

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly translate complex financial analyses into actionable insights for clients and internal teams
  • Proactive and comfortable working independently
  • Curious and motivated to develop across energy transition topics
  • Aligned with CELA’s mission to accelerate the energy transition in Latin America


Requirements

  • Previous experience in: Financial modelling, Investment analysis, Corporate finance or valuation
  • Bachelor’s degree in: Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, Accounting or related fields
  • Advanced Excel skills (mandatory)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken, mandatory)
  • Full-time availability with exclusivity
  • Availability to work primarily remote (home office)


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in renewable energy, energy transition, or power sector
  • Knowledge of Power BI or data visualization tools
  • Background in: Consulting, Investment banking, Project finance, Infrastructure or energy funds


Compensation

  • Competitive, market-aligned compensation
  • Salary negotiable based on experience

title: Scrum Master
description:
Senior Scrum Master - Customer Data Ecosystem

Brazil

Contract-to-hire


Job Description

You were made to do this work: designing new technologies, diving into data, optimizing digital experiences, and constantly developing better, faster ways to get results. You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to building technology for a purpose that matters. Here, you’ll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development while you help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.


In this role, you will:

  • Facilitate daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives for the customer data ecosystem teams
  • Remove obstacles and impediments that hinder the team’s progress, ensuring smooth and efficient workflows.
  • Coach the team on Agile principles and practices, ensuring adherence to Scrum frameworks.
  • Collaborate with product owners to manage the product backlog and ensure clear communication of requirements.
  • Track team performance metrics, such as velocity and burndown, and work to improve productivity and efficiency.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the team, encouraging the adoption of Agile best practices.
  • Foster a collaborative environment where team members feel empowered to contribute and innovate.
  • Work with legal and compliance teams to ensure that all sprints consider data privacy and regulatory requirements.
  • Facilitate the integration of compliance requirements into the agile development process.
  • Lead efforts to align Scrum practices with the organization’s digital marketing strategy and goals.
  • Provide guidance on managing dependencies between teams and coordinating cross-team collaboration.
  • Stay current with industry trends in Agile methodologies, applying relevant advancements to improve team performance.
  • Ensure that the team’s work is aligned with business objectives, delivering value to the organization.
  • Provide training and mentoring to team members and other Scrum Masters within the organization.
  • Lead efforts to resolve conflicts and challenges within the team, ensuring a positive and productive work environment.
  • Drive Change Management through coaching the team and support them on the Transformation journey by establishing clear processes and challenging them on shifting mindset
  • Oversee the integration and use of Azure Dev Ops tools within project teams to optimize collaboration, code management, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Drive the adoption of Azure DevOps features among the team, ensuring they are leveraged to enhance project transparency and delivery efficiency

title: Data Analyst | Ecommerce (Full-time Remote, BR)
description:
About Us:

Carepod is a premium humidifier brand operating in the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re growing fast and building a data-driven culture where insights actually shape decisions.

We’re looking for a Data Analyst who thinks like a business partner, not just a report builder.


What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain dashboards & projection tools such as sales, marketing, inventory, etc.
  • Analyze ecommerce & marketing data (Shopify, ads, reviews)
  • Identify trends in conversion, retention, and customer behavior
  • Support leadership with clear insights and recommendations
  • Answer real business questions, fast


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years experience as a Data Analyst
  • Strong SQL + Excel / Google Sheets
  • Experience with dashboards & KPIs
  • Exeprience with AI Automations such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, n8n, Make, Airtable, etc.
  • Ecommerce or DTC experience preferred
  • Comfortable communicating insights in English
  • Bonus: Python, BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)


Why Carepod

  • Direct exposure to leadership
  • Real impact on decisions
  • International business experience
  • Fully remote, long-term opportunity


What We Offer:

 • Fully remote work environment

 • Competitive salary

 • Flexible PTO policy

 • Opportunity to grow with a scaling e-commerce brand

 • A supportive, collaborative, and agile team culture


⸻


To Apply:

  • Send your resume and a short note about why you’re a great fit

title: Encarregado de Linha de Transmissão (Campo Grande/MS)
description:
Adecco, líder mundial de soluções de RH, está presente em 60 países, com mais de 5.500 filiais em que trabalham mais de 30.000 pessoas, em parceria com mais de 100.000 empresas clientes, distribuídas por todo o mundo. Oferecemos uma ampla variedade de serviços voltados para Recursos Humanos.

Assessoramos importante empresa no segmento de infraestruturas energéticas.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Garantir o desenvolvimento e realização de inspeções nas linhas de transmissões e seus respectivos conjuntos de operação, observando a existência de irregularidades nas instalações e equipamentos para providenciar os reparos necessários visando otimização da operação;
  • Liderar a equipe de eletricistas;
  • Elaborar relatórios sobre resultados das inspeções e manutenções efetuadas;
  • Garantir controle de defeitos e ocorrências levantados em inspeções para posterior programação de manutenção programada;
  • Executar a inspeção programada ou de emergência terrestre e aérea em linhas de transmissão, verificando a necessidade de reparos, observando o estado geral da faixa de servidão;
  • Efetuar o comissionamento de linha de transmissão, fiscalizando o estado de determinados equipamentos, visando seguir normas do manual de comissionamento;
  • Realizar manutenções preventivas, preditivas e corretivas em linhas de transmissão e seus respectivos conjuntos de operação, efetuando operações e atividades para manutenção eficaz do conjunto de linha de transmissão para garantir o pleno funcionamento das instalações elétricas;
  • Identificar e identificar falhas de operação nas linhas de transmissões para providenciar o reparo devido, escalando as torres e efetuando o conserto necessário para restabelecer a operação de concessão de energia;
  • Aderir e zelar pelo contínuo cumprimento do Programa de Integridade Corporativa - PIC e do sistema de gestão antissuborno, se comprometendo a realizar todas as suas atividades em respeito e cumprimento aos requisitos, preceitos e valores do PIC e do sistema de gestão antissuborno e a não realizar ou aceitar suborno em qualquer forma;
  • Seguir os procedimentos estabelecidos no SIG visando garantir a qualidade dos serviços, a proteção ao meio ambiente, a sua integridade física, a de outros colaboradores e das demais partes interessadas; bem como combater o suborno em todas as suas formas.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Ensino técnico completo ou superior cursando;
  • Vivência com gestão de equipe;
  • Experiência com manutenção de linha viva a partir de 230kv;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens curtas.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack pleno
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desenvolver e evoluir o aplicativo de frente de loja (PDV) e os serviços de backend associados, garantindo alta disponibilidade, performance e uma ótima experiência do usuário. Atuar na integração e homologação de terminais POS com adquirentes de pagamentos eletrônicos do mercado brasileiro e participar do ciclo de publicação de apps.


Sobre a oportunidade

Você fará parte do time de PDV, trabalhando próximo ao Tech Lead, PO, QA e Suporte N2. Esperamos autonomia para entregar funcionalidades ponta a ponta, boa comunicação e foco em qualidade, com responsabilidade sobre o que desenvolve.


Responsabilidades

  • Implementar funcionalidades end-to-end: mobile (React Native) e backend (Node.js/TypeScript)
  • Integrar e homologar SDKs/APIs de adquirentes e POS Android (testes de crédito/débito, parcelado, estorno, contactless, logs e evidências)
  • Participar do processo de publicação de apps (Google Play/App Store) ou distribuição corporativa/MDM: versionamento, assinatura e tracks
  • Desenvolver e manter APIs REST, integrações com sistemas legados e serviços terceiros
  • Escrever testes, realizar code reviews e colaborar na melhoria contínua da qualidade e performance
  • Monitorar e atuar no troubleshooting de incidentes em produção, com suporte do time
  • Documentar fluxos técnicos, integrações e decisões relevantes
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis, estimativas e planejamento
  • Apoiar pilotos/homologações em campo quando necessário (eventuais deslocamentos)


Requisitos e qualificações


Requisitos técnicos (obrigatórios)


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de software (nível Pleno), incluindo:
  • React Native (foco Android)
  • Node.js e TypeScript (APIs REST)
  • Integração com SDKs/APIs e boas práticas para fluxos de pagamento (idempotência, tratamento de erros e timeouts)
  • Banco de dados relacional (PostgreSQL) e escrita de queries performáticas,
  • Git, pipelines básicos de CI/CD e organização de ambientes (dev/homolog/produção)
  • Noções de Monitoramento e logs (ex.: Sentry, CloudWatch, Grafana/Kibana) voltados à rastreabilidade de transações
  • Noções de segurança e LGPD aplicadas a apps e APIs (armazenamento seguro, criptografia, tokens)
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação e SDKs

title: Desenvolvedor - iOS com SWIFT
description:
Oportunidade somente para desenvolvedores que possuem experiência com codificação IOS em SWIFT.


Somos uma intermediadora de demandas de desenvolvimento, atualmente temos mais de 400 projetos em andamento e muita demanda de desenvolvimento de software.


Nós trabalhamos com modelo de Ordem de Serviço, onde você seria um prestador de serviços de Desenvolvimento iOS com Swift para demandas de codificação FRONT-END e integração com APIS.


Esta oportunidade envolve o desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicativos móveis para a plataforma iOS, utilizando a linguagem Swift. As demandas incluirão a criação de telas front-end e integrar com APIs back-ends já desenvolvidas, correção de bugs existentes, a colaboração entre equipes.


Trabalhamos com o modelo de ordens de serviço pré-precificadas, onde as demandas contam com todas as informações, escopo, telas figma navegáveis e back-end feito.


Qualificações

  • Desenvolvimento de Aplicativos Móveis: Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis, com foco específico em iOS.


  • Desenvolvimento iOS: Proficiência em Swift e conhecimento das melhores práticas de desenvolvimento para a plataforma iOS.


  • Desenvolvimento de Software: Habilidades sólidas em desenvolvimento de software, incluindo design, teste e manutenção de código.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
Profitable , +100M ARRR, + 1M MAUs, +8M clients, fintech accelerated in Silicon Valley needs you!

Help us improve the lives of 34 million workers in financial distress

We are a profitable, series A startup growing 10% MoM with more than $60M of annualized revenue helping workers without access to credit. We believe we can improve the lives of Brazilian workers offering salary advances.

We are invested by Monashees, ONEVC, and YCombinator. We believe a top-performing team is the most vital factor to a startup’s success.

Position: Chief of Staff

We are looking for a Chief of Staff to be the CEO’s strategic partner—helping drive priorities, bring clarity and alignment across teams, and maximize effectiveness.

This is a career accelerator role: you’ll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution, with direct exposure to company decision-making, fundraising, growth, and operations. You’ll be embedded in the hardest challenges of scaling a high-growth fintech in one of the world’s most dynamic markets.

Your work will focus on three areas:

1. Strategic Execution & Decision Support

  • Partner with the CEO to prioritize and drive the most critical company-wide initiatives.
  • Dig into strategic questions—pricing, incentives, product-market fit, operational efficiency.
  • Generate high-leverage insights from data, market research, and direct user feedback.
  • Prepare decision frameworks, board materials, and briefing docs to enable fast, high-quality decisions.

2. Cross-Functional Alignment & Special Projects

  • Act as a connector across Product, Marketing, Finance, Credit and Operations—ensuring priorities are clear and execution sharp.
  • Identify and remove roadblocks, whether data gaps, misalignment, or process bottlenecks.
  • Drive high-impact special projects—ranging from new product launches to operational improvements.
  • Serve as a trusted thought partner to executives, bringing an enterprise-wide perspective.

3. CEO Leverage & Investor Communications

  • Ensure the CEO’s time and focus are on the highest-leverage activities by filtering noise and structuring decisions.
  • Craft crisp, compelling communications—internal memos, board decks, investor updates, and team announcements.
  • Act as a sounding board: challenge assumptions, pressure-test ideas, and refine strategy.



Who You Are:

This role is for a sharp, driven, adaptable operator who thrives in ambiguity and wants a front-row seat to building a category-defining fintech.

You are:

  • A Strategic Thinker Who Executes: You break down complex problems into clear insights and actions. You anticipate second-order effects and make things happen.
  • A Strong Communicator & Influencer: You can synthesize complexity into clarity, influence across levels, and drive alignment.
  • Comfortable in Ambiguity: You thrive in messy, undefined challenges and move quickly to bring order.
  • Curious to learn & eager to Grow: You want exposure to strategy, fundraising, and scaling operations—and see this role as a launchpad for future leadership.
Qualifications

We don’t expect a single “right” background, but you likely have:

  • 2–4 years of experience in consulting, investment banking, VC/PE, or high-growth startups.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills; comfort with SQL, Excel, Python and business metrics a plus.
  • Proven track record of cross-functional project execution.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English and Portuguese.
  • Ability to take ownership and deliver results in unstructured environments.
Why This Role?
  • Unparalleled Exposure: Work side-by-side with a CEO who has scaled fintech to millions of users.
  • AI-native Company : We’re turning all departments into execution driven functions powered by LLMs and automation.
  • High-Impact Work: Tackle the most pressing strategic challenges at Brazil’s fastest-growing salary advance platform.
  • Career Acceleration: A launchpad into future leadership roles in fintech, strategy, or entrepreneurship.
  • Mission That Matters: Directly impact the financial lives of millions of Brazilian workers.
About us:
  • Fully remote - we meet 4 times a year in São Paulo (flight & accommodations on us)
  • We pay above market with top edge stock options package
  • Twice weekly AI classes
  • CLT / PJ
Process:
  • CV Screening, 2 interviews, 2 cases
  • Applicants reviewed on rolling basis
Apply now

title: Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Specialist - Software Engineer

Experience: 7–11 Years

Domain: Salesforce Analytics / CRM Analytics

Location - Brazil ( Remote)


Roles & Leadership Responsibilities


•Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for Salesforce CRM Analytics capabilities and best practices.

•Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical analytics solutions.

•Provide strategic recommendations based on analytics findings to drive business outcomes.

•Mentor and guide junior analysts and developers, fostering best practices in CRM Analytics development.

•Identify gaps in existing analytics capabilities and propose innovative, value-driven solutions.


Required Skills & Qualifications


•7–11 years of experience in CRM Analytics, Salesforce Analytics, or related BI/analytics platforms.

•Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM Analytics (Einstein Analytics / Tableau CRM).

•Expertise in dashboard design, data modeling, and advanced analytics techniques.

•Strong understanding of customer data, CRM processes, and business KPIs.

•Experience working with large datasets and complex data structures.

•Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

•Proven ability to lead analytics projects in an enterprise environment.

title: Payments Product Operations Manager - Dubai or Abu Dhabi Relocation
description:
We are looking for an experienced Payments Product Operations Manager to improve efficiency, scalability, and innovation on our payments platform. This is a key role for someone passionate about streamlining operations and enhancing how digital financial products are delivered.


The Company

This fast-growing digital finance platform is transforming personal and business banking in the MENA region. Focused on modernising payments, it delivers seamless, customer-friendly solutions. With a culture of innovation, agility, and teamwork, the company values continuous improvement across all areas of the business.


What We’re Hiring

You will work across payments operations, collaborating with Product, Technology, Compliance, Risk, and external vendors to improve processes and performance. Key responsibilities include:


  • Optimise operations and implement process improvements.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives to boost efficiency and scalability.
  • Support the development of new payment products and features.
  • Use data to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Create dashboards and KPIs to track performance.


The ideal candidate will have:

  • Experience in payments or product operations, process optimisation.
  • Solid knowledge of payment systems, workflows, and regulations.
  • Track record of driving efficiency, automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Skilled in collaborating with Product and Technology teams.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.


What’s in it for you:

  • Join a modern, fast-scaling fintech in the MENA region.
  • Work on products that are actively transforming how people invest.
  • Diverse, international, high-performance team.
  • Competitive package, bonuses + relocation package, hybrid working, generous holiday allowance.
  • High standard of life in Dubai or Abu Dhabi.

title: QAQC Senior Analyst
description:
Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a fast-growing, New York-based, MEP engineering firm that has completed over 300 projects and designed more than 3 million square feet of built space in NY.


We’re hiring a Brazil-based, remote professional to own and scale our QAQC design process so every project consistently meets our standards as we grow.


Important


This role is not about line-by-line reviewing design deliverables. Instead, you will ensure the design process is executed correctly and that all quality-check steps are completed on 100% of projects, minimizing design errors, communication breakdowns, and rework.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time (remote)
  • Competitive total compensation


What you’ll do


  • Own the QAQC process end-to-end across MEP projects: define, implement, and continuously improve checklists, stage gates, and “definition of done” criteria.
  • Guarantee compliance: ensure all required quality checks are completed (with traceability) on every project—no exceptions.
  • Standardize workflows: templates, file organization, naming conventions, coordination routines, handoff requirements, and internal documentation.
  • Improve communication and handoffs: reduce information loss between teams, disciplines, and stakeholders.
  • Track quality metrics: build dashboards and weekly reporting around nonconformities, rework drivers, cycle time, recurring errors, and process adherence.
  • Root-cause and prevention: investigate failures, implement corrective actions, and ensure improvements stick.


Requirements

  • Advanced English (written + spoken) to work with a US-based team and clients.
  • Experience in AEC/MEP environments (MEP design, engineering, BIM coordination, project delivery, design ops, PMO, QA/QC)
  • Strong process ownership mindset: disciplined, organized, and consistent follow-through.
  • Ability to drive compliance across teams (without being the “reviewer of everything”).
  • Comfortable creating SOPs, checklists, and governance routines that scale.


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with tools like Revit, AutoCAD, Bluebeam, ACC/BIM 360, Asana/Monday/Jira, etc.
  • Track record of improving quality and reducing rework through better systems.


Selection Process

  • Application: apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with you CV, English experience and CRM background
  • Screening: English and communication assessment
  • Sales case: short technical challenge
  • Interviews: with leadership and our CEO
  • Offer


Why join Downtown?

  • Strategic role in a fast-growing NYC company
  • Our clients love us
  • Strong engineering team in all trades
  • Startup mentality towards growth and team building
  • We only hire people who excel
